strings.TR_MUSIC_NOTE_RATE: 48 kHz is recommended for music. Lower rates use less bandwidth. The 3DS resamples for its output.
strings.TR_MUSIC_NOTE_CHANNELS: Stereo preserves left and right detail. Mono combines both channels and uses half the bandwidth.
strings.TR_MUSIC_NOTE_BUFFER: 1,024 KB is recommended. Going below this is not recommended, especially on Old 3DS.
strings.TR_MUSIC_NOTE_VOLUME: Music volume is separate from video. 100% keeps the original level without extra amplification.
strings.TR_MUSIC_NOTE_DEFAULTS: Restores 48 kHz, stereo, a 1,024 KB buffer and 100% volume. Choose Save to apply.
strings.TR_MUSIC_NOTE_SAVE: Saves for future songs. Quality changes briefly reload the current song at the same position.
